profile.headline: QA Software Engineer II | Test Automation & SDET | C#, Selenium, NUnit, Azure DevOps CI/CD, SQL Server | AI-Assisted Testing (GitHub Copilot)
profile.summary:
I build test automation that lets teams ship faster with fewer production defects.

With 7+ years in enterprise Agile/Scrum environments, I've designed automation frameworks from scratch in C#, Selenium WebDriver, and NUnit. At Ampersand and GasOps IQ, I replaced legacy manual testing with scalable automated suites that:

• Cut release verification from 2 days to 3 hours
• Scaled regression coverage across critical workflows
• Reduced production defect escapes by 45%

I also own the daily CI/CD pipeline health in Azure DevOps, triaging failures in real time and keeping builds release-ready under a 2-hour SLA. As a multi-platform subject matter expert across Linear, Streaming, and Container architectures, I work closely with engineers, database teams, and Product Owners to clarify requirements before code is written, because the cheapest bug to fix is the one that never gets built. I'm continually modernizing my frameworks, including using GitHub Copilot to speed up refactoring and reduce long-term maintenance.

Core skills: Test Automation (Page Object Model) | CI/CD (Azure DevOps Pipelines) | API Testing (Postman, REST/JSON) | SQL Server & SQL | Code Reviews & Defect Lifecycle Management

Tech: C#, Selenium WebDriver, NUnit, Postman, SQL Server, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, Visual Studio, Azure DevOps, GitHub Copilot, Jira, Git

Open to Senior QA Automation Engineer and SDET roles. Always happy to connect with fellow QA, SDET, and DevOps professionals. Feel free to reach out.

positions.title: QA Software Engineer - II
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented a scalable C#, Selenium WebDriver, and NUnit automated regression framework using modular Page Object Model (POM) patterns, expanding test coverage by 40% and cutting release verification time by 80% (from 2 days to 3 hours).
• Leveraged GitHub Copilot to accelerate test script automation, refactoring, and standardize helper utilities, significantly improving long-term framework maintainability and delivery velocity.
• Orchestrated daily Azure DevOps pipeline executions, triaged failed test runs, isolated environmental issues from code defects, and resolved automation-script flakiness within a strict 2-hour SLA to maintain continuous release readiness.
• Validated complex, asynchronous, event-driven microservices and data pipelines across AWS (including Amazon S3 event notifications, AWS Lambda functions, and Amazon SNS topics), ensuring end-to-end data integrity.
• Served as the primary QA Subject Matter Expert (SME) across three core product lines—Linear, Streaming, and Container—guiding cross-functional engineering squads and supporting zero-defect deployments across 40+ production releases.
• Wrote technical onboarding documentation for new engineers and started weekly automation pull request (PR) and code reviews, eliminating redundant test scripts by 20% and coaching the team on quality practices.

positions.title: QA Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Engineered complex SQL queries in Microsoft SQL Server to audit backend state transitions and transactional integrity, reducing data-related defect escapes by 20% across development and QA environments.
• Executed functional, regression, and REST API testing using Postman and Swagger, validating payload contracts and supporting the successful launch of 15+ major platform features.
• Managed end-to-end defect lifecycles inside Azure DevOps, decreasing resolution times by 30% through clearer steps-to-reproduce and log attachments.
• Investigated real-time client production bugs for Beta Android platform users, engineering immediate technical workarounds within an average 2-hour turnaround while delivering precise root-cause diagnostics to core engineering.
• Collaborated closely with software developers to review test plans against core requirements, driving alignment via daily stand-ups, retrospective meetings, and iteration reviews.

positions.title: Software Developer In Test
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained automated UI regression suites using Selenium WebDriver and C#, validating core platform workflows across QA, staging, and production environments.
• Conducted REST API verification using Postman by inspecting JSON request/response payloads, HTTP status codes, and schema mappings; wrote targeted SQL queries to verify backend table updates and ensure end-to-end data consistency.
• Conducted comprehensive smoke, functional, and regression test suites across QA, Staging, and Production deployment boundaries.
• Tracked emerging bugs alongside developers inside Jira; isolated system execution logs to construct exhaustive, developer-ready defect profiles

positions.title: QA Analyst
positions.description:
• Developed and executed functional, smoke, and regression test cases across multiple environment boundaries.
• Utilized complex SQL queries to audit backend database layers and perform data validation testing.

projects.title: Portfolio Mobile App Testing
projects.description:
• I have created Portillo's mobile app testing using Java, Appium, Selenium Automation and TestNG Framework.
• I created automation testcases for Sign Up, Login and Add Items to Cart.

projects.title: United Airlines Web Application Testing
projects.description:
• Used Java Selenium Web Driver and Maven repository to automation United Airlines registration and login page.
• For registration, it reads the test data from the excel sheet and imports to the specified element.
• It also writes the security questions and answers into the same excel for later use during the Login.
• For login, it reads test data from the excel and correctly selects the write questions and answers from the drop-down and successfully login to the account.
